verdict.rationale: Every gstack skill ships a SKILL.md describing what it does (review, qa, ship, cso, autoplan, learn, etc.) and docs/skills.md gives a catalog of skill purposes, plus a router SKILL.md that dispatches requests to the right skill — giving strong 'what it does' documentation. However, explicit per-skill activation triggers/conditions (exactly when a skill fires vs. is manually invoked) are not clearly documented beyond the router description, and community commentary flags real unpredictability concerns about autonomous behavior across repos, which the docs don't directly resolve. Missing for 10: explicit activation/trigger conditions per skill, and independent verification that skill behavior matches docs before it 'surprises' a user.
